note: Scout re-scored with the v2 category tree (254 sub-categories); same single fixture candidates call and bar as v2 (10 kept, every kept one classified); nothing stored or filed.

kept.name: Visa
kept.why: Visa’s global identity refresh introduces a standalone V and a custom typeface, Visa Sans, giving slug two specific changes to watch for on the homepage.

kept.name: HOFF
kept.why: HOFF’s Madrid flagship uses a colourful holiday sculpture to present its shoes, a seasonal visual direction worth comparing with its homepage.

kept.name: Programa
kept.why: Programa’s redesign puts the less visible work of interior design, from tracking dimensions to counting materials, at the centre of its pitch to studios.

kept.name: Mondaine
kept.why: Mondaine’s Solar Skeleton cuts a circular opening in the dial so the solar plates become part of the watch face rather than a hidden feature.

kept.name: Volvo Cars
kept.why: Volvo Cars traces the EX60’s colours, materials and lighting to forest walks and Nordic seas, giving its Scandinavian design story concrete details.

kept.name: Fireclay Tile
kept.why: Fireclay Tile translates familiar textile patterns, including plaids and stripes, into hand-painted ceramic tiles for its Idyllwild collection.

kept.name: Burberry
kept.why: Burberry’s V&A Christmas tree uses biscuit-tin lids and horse brasses to tell a holiday story about British traditions.

kept.name: Dior
kept.why: Dior chose animator Sylvain Chomet to direct its holiday short, making his illustration style a reference point for the seasonal campaign.

kept.name: Teemill
kept.why: Teemill pitches print-on-demand merchandise through specific choices about how it is made and shipped: renewable energy, organic materials and plastic-free packaging.

kept.name: Davis Furniture
kept.why: The concealed engineering of Davis Furniture’s Laken nesting tables leaves their sculptural double-cone bases as the defining visual feature.
